pretest.title: Before You Begin
pretest.subtitle: Take a moment to review the instructions before starting your assessment.
pretest.instruction1: Answer each question honestly — there are no right or wrong answers in the personality and interest sections.
pretest.instruction2: Read each question carefully. You can pause and return at any time without losing progress.
pretest.instruction3: Sections include a timer. Complete questions within the allotted time for best accuracy.
pretest.instruction4: Take short breaks between sections to maintain focus.
pretest.setupUnavailableBody: We could not load your purchased assessment right now.
pretest.introBody: Please review these important instructions carefully before starting your assessment.
pretest.timing2: Your progress is saved automatically after each answer.
pretest.timing3: The timer continues from where you left off if you resume later.
pretest.timing4: Finish every section before submitting the final assessment.
pretest.tech1: Use a stable internet connection for the smoothest experience.
pretest.tech2: Keep your browser updated to the latest version.
pretest.tech3: Desktop or laptop is recommended, but mobile is supported.
pretest.tech4: Avoid opening extra tabs or pop-up blockers during the test.
pretest.rule1: Answer honestly. There are no right or wrong answers for many sections.
pretest.rule2: Once your final assessment is submitted, it will be used to generate your report.
pretest.rule3: Do not refresh the page repeatedly during a section.
pretest.rule4: Take the test in a calm environment without distractions.
pretest.checkConnection: I have checked my internet connection and browser compatibility.
pretest.checkRules: I have read and understood all the instructions and rules.
